blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Investors can buy into GCash operator Mynt Inc.’s initial public offering (IPO) at P6.60 per share, after the company set its final offer price 34 percent below the earlier P10 ceiling. On Oct. 1, the company confirmed the price in a notice addressed to the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Philippine Stock Exchange. READ: GCash IPO seen testing PH market appetite for mega deals At P6.60, the final offer price is P3.40 below the earlier ceiling.
